hub_subtitle: Destravar a conversa — da feira automotiva internacional à viagem sem preocupação

lesson.menu_desc: Call a parts supplier in Germany and talk about what is happening now -- present continuous
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- On the Phone
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Camillo Furlan Alfredini | Lesson 9 -- On the Phone
lesson.grammar_point: present continuous for now (I am calling, they are packing, is it leaving?)

listenings.text: Hello, and thank you for calling Kessler Brakes. Right now, all our team members are helping other customers. Please stay on the line. We are working hard on all orders this week, so deliveries are taking two or three days. You can also send us an email. Thank you for waiting.

Hi, this is Jonas from the Kessler warehouse. Right now, I'm standing next to your order. My team is packing the last two boxes. The truck is waiting outside, and it is leaving at four o'clock. I'm sending you the invoice by email now. Your brakes are arriving in Brazil next week.

extra_audio.text: Camillo is at his shop, and he is calling Kessler Brakes in Germany. Laura answers the phone. He says: I am calling about my order. Laura says: The team is packing it right now. The truck is leaving today, and I'm sending the invoice now. Camillo is happy, and he says thank you.
